title: Shared value types
description: Integer scales from ADR 0011. The limit is the largest integer that JavaScript represents exactly, so a value means the same in TypeScript and in Java.

unit_price_e4.description: Unit price in ten-thousandths of a peso: $12.50 is 125000.

quantity_milli.description: Quantity in thousandths of its unit: 3.275 m is 3275.

unit.description: Base unit of a quantity. A roll or a box converts to one of these.
